feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Senior police officer to go on trial over sexual assault claim
articles.summary: A senior police officer accused of sexual assault will stand trial.

articles.title: Rare ant colony stolen from nature reserve in Devon
articles.summary: Conservationists have said the theft of a rare ant colony from a nature reserve in Devon is a "significant loss" which "sets back years" of hard work by staff and volunteers.

articles.title: Barclays to begin car finance payouts months before outcome of legal challenge
articles.summary: Barclays will this week become the first major UK lender to begin offering compensation payments to former motor finance customers, even as the industry's big financiers face waiting months for the outcome of challenges to a £9bn redress scheme.

articles.title: Ministers to hold urgent talks with Poundland chiefs
articles.summary: The government is to hold an urgent meeting with Poundland bosses amid growing recriminations over the discount retailer's ownership.

articles.title: 'Manipulated in our darkest hour': Family of Henry Nowak say police failed them
articles.summary: The family of murdered student Henry Nowak say they have been "failed multiple times" by the police response to the 18-year-old's death.

articles.title: British backpackers in Australia could face changes to visa rules
articles.summary: British backpackers in Australia could be forced to spend more time in regional areas under proposed changes to the country's working holiday visa.

articles.title: Man dead and boy injured after being approached by police
articles.summary: An 18-year-old man has died and a boy was injured in a collision following an approach from patrolling police officers.

articles.title: Suspected far-right activists from Britain 'with tear gas bombs' detained in France
articles.summary: Five suspected far-right activists from Britain were detained in northern France last Thursday, according to authorities.

articles.title: National Grid sparks deal to pave way for giant UK data centre
articles.summary: National Grid has struck a deal paving the way for Britain’s biggest electricity substation to be built on Teesside as the government races to avoid missing out on global demand for AI infrastructure development.

articles.title: The King to speak about slavery with 'unflinching honesty'
articles.summary: The King will speak about slavery with "unflinching honesty" and "sincere sorrow" in a speech to Commonwealth leaders amid increasing pressure for Britain to offer an apology over its role in the transatlantic slave trade.
